{{Quote|Lord, I can offer you a quarter of our total annual teniline output in exchange for&mdash;|The viceroy of Bheriz, to Jabba Desilijic Tiure|<ref name="TCWnovel" />}}
'''Teniline''' was a [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] produced on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] celestial body [[Bheriz]]. It was a vital resource in the manufacture of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]], and in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[viceroy of Bheriz]] negotiated a deal with [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] in which Bheriz exchanged half its [[Local year|annual]] teniline output for free passage along [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-controlled [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]].

==Description==
Teniline was a [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] of which there were deposits at the celestial body [[Bheriz]]<ref name="TCWnovel" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Bheriz sector/Legends|Bheriz sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Bheriz system/Legends|Bheriz system]]</ref> Granules of teniline were processed by [[Bherizian]] [[Miner/Legends|miners]], and the mineral was an important resource in the manufacture of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]].<ref name="TCWnovel" />

==History==
[[File:Bheriz-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Bheriz possessed deposits of teniline.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the [[viceroy of Bheriz]] traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. There, he intended to negotiate a deal with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] in which Bheriz would trade a quarter of its total [[Local year|annual]] output of teniline in exchange for free passage along Hutt-controlled [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]]. Jabba was keen on acquiring Bheriz's teniline due to its commercial value in the ongoing [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Accordingly, he was prepared to take the teniline reserves by force if the [[Viceroy/Legends|viceroy]] asked too high a price for them but preferred negotiation as a cheaper and easier approach.<ref name="TCWnovel" />

At the same time, the crime [[Lord/Legends|lord's]] market analysts also predicted that the recent development of hyperdrive components using [[hexophilenine]] instead of teniline would cause the collapse of the latter's prices within five [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. To that end, when Jabba increased the demands on Bheriz during the negotiation with its viceroy, he only required half of the celestial body's teniline output in order to obtain the mineral but also avoid being left with too much stock of it in his possession.<ref name="TCWnovel" />

==Behind the scenes==
Teniline was mentioned in [[Karen Traviss]]'<ref name="TCWnovel" /> [[July 26]], [[2008]]<ref name="YearByYear">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]] of<ref name="TCWnovel" /> the [[August 15]], 2008 [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|film]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (multimedia project)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' multimedia project]].<ref name="YearByYear" />
